title: Size bound for a low-degree Fourier family
statement: Let $n,k$ be natural numbers and let $P$ be a subset of the $n$ coordinates. Form the Fourier family on the coordinates outside $P$, using degrees at most $\lfloor 3k/4\rfloor$. The base-two logarithm rounded up of the number of sets in this family is at most $(\lfloor 3k/4\rfloor+1)(n+2)$.
hypotheses_covered: Subset P of the n coordinates
